description: This file defines the abstract class 'source', which serves as a base class for various data source connectors within the SuiteCRM system. It includes configuration handling, mapping, and metadata functionalities relevant to connectors used for data integration.

classes.name: source
classes.description: An abstract base class for connector sources in SuiteCRM, providing configuration management, loading, and common interface methods for data connectors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the source object by loading configuration, mapping, and vardefs.

methods.name: loadMapping
methods.description: Loads the mapping definitions for the source from the filesystem.

methods.name: saveMappingHook
methods.description: Hook method called when saving mapping, intended for subclasses to override if needed.

methods.name: loadVardefs
methods.description: Loads vardef definitions for the source from the filesystem.

methods.name: getFieldsWithParams
methods.description: Returns fields in vardefs matching a specific parameter name and value.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Serializes and saves the source configuration to a PHP file.

methods.name: initConfig
methods.description: Decrypts encrypted config properties; prevents reinitialization if already decrypted.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration for the source from PHP files, with fallback to default property requirement.

methods.name: filterAllowedModules
methods.description: Filters a list of modules; default implementation allows all.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns the current mapping array.

methods.name: getOriginalMapping
methods.description: Retrieves the original mapping definitions from filesystem.

methods.name: setMapping
methods.description: Sets the current mapping array.

methods.name: getFieldDefs
methods.description: Returns the vardef fields array.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the current configuration array, initializing and decrypting if necessary.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration array, marking it as decrypted.

methods.name: setEAPM
methods.description: Associates an ExternalAPIBase object with the source.

methods.name: getEAPM
methods.description: Retrieves the associated ExternalAPIBase object.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets properties within the config properties array.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties, decrypting if needed.

methods.name: propertyExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific property exists and is non-empty.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a single property value, decrypting if necessary.

methods.name: hasTestingEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if the source has testing enabled.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Performs a test of the data source; default returns false.

methods.name: isEnabledInWizard
methods.description: Checks if the source is enabled in the wizard.

methods.name: isEnabledInHover
methods.description: Checks if hover links are enabled for this source.

methods.name: isEnabledInAdminProperties
methods.description: Checks if source appears in the admin properties view.

methods.name: isEnabledInAdminMapping
methods.description: Checks if source appears in the admin mapping view.

methods.name: isEnabledInAdminDisplay
methods.description: Checks if source appears in the admin display view.

methods.name: isEnabledInAdminSearch
methods.description: Checks if source appears in the admin search view.

methods.name: getRequiredConfigFields
methods.description: Returns an array of required config field keys.

methods.name: isRequiredConfigFieldsSet
methods.description: Checks if all required config fields are set.

methods.name: getRequiredConfigFieldsForButton
methods.description: Returns keys that are required before the 'Get Data' button is enabled.

methods.name: isRequiredConfigFieldsForButtonSet
methods.description: Checks if all required config fields for the button are set.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs information with the class name or property name.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a single item; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve list of items; to be implemented by subclasses.
